OccFusion: Real-Time 3D Occupancy Prediction with Multi-Sensor Fusion
Zhang, Y. 等 5 位 · 10-24 · cs.RO（主分类）
Occupancy 网格的实时多传感器融合预测，推理 42 FPS。
现有方法单依赖视觉、测距噪声大，远场与遮挡区域空洞明显。
LiDAR-相机时空注意力 + 轻量 BEV 融合头，端到端联合训练。
mIoU +3.1，A100 42FPS / Orin 11FPS，训练与部署脚本齐全。
The perception of 3D occupancy grids has become a cornerstone of modern autonomous driving stacks, yet
fusing heterogeneous sensors at frame rate remains challenging. We propose OccFusion, a unified…
